skill.name: brainstorming
skill.description: Guides collaborative brainstorming before creative implementation by exploring user intent, constraints, alternatives, and design details.
skill.summary: Turns early ideas into reviewed designs and implementation-ready plans.
skill.author: Cycleaddict

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a Markdown placeholder wrapped in backticks, not executable shell or Ruby code. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or hidden execution behavior was found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 38 uses backticks for a Markdown filename template, not Ruby or shell execution. The skill contains prompt instructions only and no executable code path.

content.value_statement: Early feature ideas often lack clear scope, trade-offs, and validation. This skill guides structured dialogue that turns uncertain ideas into reviewed designs.
actual_capabilities: Reviews project context before shaping a new idea.
Asks one focused question at a time.
Compares two or three approaches with trade-offs.
Presents design sections for incremental validation.
Covers architecture, data flow, error handling, and testing.
Guides design documentation after the user validates the plan.
limitations: It does not implement the design by itself.
It depends on accurate project context and user answers.
It may need separate planning skills for detailed task breakdowns.
It can create documentation only when file access is available.

use_cases.title: Clarify Feature Direction
use_cases.description: Turn a rough feature idea into goals, constraints, and success criteria before work starts.

use_cases.title: Compare Implementation Options
use_cases.description: Explore architecture and component choices with trade-offs before changing behavior.

use_cases.title: Prepare Build Specifications
use_cases.description: Convert a product concept into a validated design that can guide later implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Feature Brainstorm
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the brainstorming skill to help me define a new feature. Ask one question at a time and start with project context.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Approaches
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the brainstorming skill to compare two or three ways to solve this problem: [describe problem]. Recommend one option with reasoning.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the brainstorming skill to review this proposed architecture: [paste summary]. Identify gaps in data flow, errors, and testing.

prompt_templates.title: Turn Discovery Into a Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the brainstorming skill to run discovery for [project or feature]. After validation, draft the design in short sections.

output_examples.input: I want to add team invitations to my app.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks about roles, invitation flow, expiration rules, and success criteria. It then compares simple email invites, admin-created accounts, and domain-based access.
The assistant reviews existing pages, asks one question at a time, and presents a validated layout, data model, error states, and testing plan.

output_examples.input: I am unsure which search approach to build.
output_examples.output: The assistant outlines client-side filtering, server search, and hosted search. It recommends an approach based on scale and constraints.

best_practices: Share current project goals and constraints before asking for options.
Answer each question with enough detail to support trade-off analysis.
Validate each design section before moving to implementation planning.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for implementation before the design is validated.
Do not skip project context when behavior changes affect existing users.
Do not request many unrelated ideas in one brainstorming session.

faq.question: Does this skill write code?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on discovery, design, and documentation before implementation.

faq.question: Can it help with non-code projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure ideas, requirements, and decisions for many creative or planning tasks.

faq.question: Why does it ask one question at a time?
faq.answer: Single questions reduce confusion and make each design decision easier to validate.

faq.question: Does it choose a final approach?
faq.answer: It recommends an approach after comparing options and explaining trade-offs.

faq.question: Can it create a design document?
faq.answer: Yes. After validation, it can guide a design document for the project.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
